text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The outcome of the Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan defeated Nishino Flower. 
However, she couldn't completely overwhelm 
her with cuteness, so her satisfaction was 
only lukewarm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into town, the place was abuzz 
after her showdown with Nishino Flower 
went viral on Umatter. Curren Chan's 
popularity skyrocketed overnight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by the sheer excitement, Curren 
Chan found a hint for her future plans—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Setting her sights on the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen, she decides to enter its trial 
race, the Ocean Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan was defeated by Nishino 
Flower. However, realizing there's still 
room for her cuteness to grow, she 
rejoices.
